失效证据：TARGET、BRANCH_OLD、OLD_BASE、remote_oid

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# 刷新目标
git fetch origin main

# 只 fetch 一次 mybr（选择不更新 tracking ref 的形式）
git fetch origin mybr:refs/heads/.mybr-oid

# 立刻保存 $remote_oid
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse refs/heads/.mybr-oid)

# 完整拓扑命令和右侧非 0 的停止注释
sides=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr@{u}...mybr)
right=$(echo "$sides" | cut -f2)
[ "$right" -ne 0 ] && echo "错误：右侧非 0（本地领先 $right），需先 push 再 rebase" && exit 1

# Rebase
git rebase origin/main mybr

# 显式 OID lease push
git push origin mybr:mybr --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid

# Push 后 fetch
git fetch origin mybr
```

失效证据：旧评审线程、approval、mergeable、CI 状态

```bash
git fetch origin
git fetch origin mybr:
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
# 检查拓扑：右侧非 0 表示远端有新提交，禁止 rebase
right=$(git rev-list --left-right --count mybr...$remote_oid | awk '{print $2}')
if [ "$right" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "右侧非 0：远端有新提交，禁止 rebase"
  exit 1
fi
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:$remote_oid origin mybr
git fetch origin mybr
```

```bash
git fetch origin main
git fetch origin mybr:
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
BRANCH_OLD=$(git rev-parse mybr)
OLD_BASE=$(git merge-base origin/main "$BRANCH_OLD")
if git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main "$BRANCH_OLD"; then
  echo "分支已含该目标，无需更新"
elif [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "分支落后，需先更新到 origin/main"
else
  echo "merge-base 出错（非 0/1），先排查别当落后处理" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git rebase origin/main
git push origin mybr --force-with-lease="mybr:$remote_oid"
git fetch origin mybr
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# 刷新目标
git fetch -q origin main

# 只 fetch 一次 mybr
git fetch -q origin mybr

# 立刻保存 $remote_oid
remote_oid=$(git rev-parse origin/mybr)

# 完整拓扑命令
TARGET=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
BRANCH_OLD=$(git rev-parse mybr)
OLD_BASE=$(git merge-base "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD")
if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$TARGET" "$BRANCH_OLD"; then
  echo "分支已含该目标，无需更新"
elif [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "分支落后，需先更新到 $TARGET"
else
  echo "merge-base 出错（非 0/1），先排查别当落后处理" && exit 1
fi

# rebase
git rebase "$TARGET"

# 显式 OID lease push
git push --force-with-lease=mybr:"$remote_oid" origin mybr

# push 后 fetch
git fetch -q origin mybr
```
